verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents connecting multiple Gmail and Outlook accounts, including work, personal, and side projects, and switching between them inside one app. Its calendar view also consolidates calendars across those accounts. Every provider statement names only Gmail and Outlook, so IMAP, a third of the story, is unsupported. Missing for 10: IMAP/other-provider support, evidence of a unified cross-account inbox rather than switching, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-account use.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place

citations.quote: you can instantly switch between Outlook and Gmail accounts without switching apps.
Connect all your Gmail and Outlook accounts, including work, personal, and side projects.
You can add all your Gmail and Outlook account calendars, and easily toggle them on and off. One single, consolidated view when you need it
Built for teams that use Gmail or Outlook
